```{ojs}
//| label: playground-ui

d3 = require("d3@7")

// ── Layout shell ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layout = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.id = "playground-layout";

  // ── TOP BAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const topBar = document.createElement("div");
  topBar.id = "top-bar";
  topBar.innerHTML = `<h1 class="title">Bias Data Playground</h1>`;

  const downloadBtn = document.createElement("button");
  downloadBtn.className = "train-btn";
  downloadBtn.id = "download-btn";
  downloadBtn.style.width = "auto";
  downloadBtn.style.minWidth = "160px";
  downloadBtn.innerHTML = `<span class="btn-spinner"></span> <span id="download-btn-label">Download CSV</span>`;
  downloadBtn.addEventListener("click", () => window._downloadCSV && window._downloadCSV());
  topBar.append(downloadBtn);

  // ── SIDEBAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sidebar = document.createElement("div");
  sidebar.id = "sidebar";

  const biasSection = document.createElement("div");
  biasSection.innerHTML = `<p class="sidebar-section-title">Bias Configuration</p>`;
  const biasCard = document.createElement("div");
  biasCard.className = "controls-card";
  biasCard.append(
    viewof_total_samples,
    document.createElement("hr"),
    viewof_base_rate_diff,
    viewof_feature_predictivity,
    viewof_proxies,
    viewof_task_diff,
    viewof_label_bias
  );
  biasSection.append(biasCard);
  sidebar.append(biasSection);

  // ── MAIN CONTENT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const mainContent = document.createElement("div");
  mainContent.id = "main-content";

  const chartArea = document.createElement("div");
  chartArea.id = "chart-area";
  chartArea.style.display = "flex";
  chartArea.style.flexDirection = "column";
  chartArea.style.gap = "1rem";
  chartArea.style.width = "100%";
  
  const statsContainer = document.createElement("div");
  statsContainer.id = "stats-container";
  
  const chartsWrapper = document.createElement("div");
  chartsWrapper.style.display = "flex";
  chartsWrapper.style.gap = "1.5rem";
  chartsWrapper.style.flexWrap = "wrap";
  
  // Train Chart
  const trainChartWrapper = document.createElement("div");
  const trainLabel = document.createElement("h3");
  trainLabel.textContent = "Train Set (Biased)";
  trainLabel.style.color = "#cbd5e1";
  trainLabel.style.margin = "0 0 0.5rem 0";
  const trainChartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  trainChartContainer.className = "chart-container"; 
  trainChartContainer.id = "chart-container";
  trainChartWrapper.append(trainLabel, trainChartContainer);
  
  // Test Chart & Metrics
  const testChartWrapper = document.createElement("div");
  const testLabel = document.createElement("h3");
  testLabel.textContent = "Test Set (Clean & Balanced)";
  testLabel.style.color = "#cbd5e1";
  testLabel.style.margin = "0 0 0.5rem 0";
  const testChartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  testChartContainer.className = "chart-container"; 
  testChartContainer.id = "chart-container-test";
  
  const evalMetricsContainer = document.createElement("div");
  evalMetricsContainer.id = "eval-metrics-container";
  evalMetricsContainer.style.marginTop = "1rem";
  
  testChartWrapper.append(testLabel, testChartContainer, evalMetricsContainer);
  
  chartsWrapper.append(trainChartWrapper, testChartWrapper);
  
  chartArea.append(statsContainer, chartsWrapper);

  mainContent.append(chartArea);
  root.append(topBar, sidebar, mainContent);
  return root;
}

viewof_feature_predictivity = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Global Feature Predictivity (0=Base, 1=Perfect)"})
viewof_proxies = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Proxies / Separability (0=Base, 1=Perfect)"})
viewof_task_diff = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Task Difficulty (0=Base, 1=Max)"})
viewof_label_bias = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Label Bias (0=None, 1=Max)"})

viewof_base_rate_diff = Inputs.select([
  "0.50 / 0.50",
  "0.25 / 0.50",
  "0.25 / 0.75",
  "0.50 / 0.25",
  "0.50 / 0.75",
  "0.75 / 0.25",
  "0.75 / 0.50"
], {value: "0.50 / 0.50", label: "Base Rates (Priv / Disadv)"})

viewof_total_samples = Inputs.range([1000, 10000], {value: 5000, step: 1000, label: "Dataset Size"})

feature_predictivity = Generators.input(viewof_feature_predictivity)
proxies = Generators.input(viewof_proxies)
task_diff = Generators.input(viewof_task_diff)
label_bias = Generators.input(viewof_label_bias)
base_rate_diff = Generators.input(viewof_base_rate_diff)
total_samples = Generators.input(viewof_total_samples)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: reactive-stats

updateStats = {
  const container = document.getElementById("stats-container");
  if (!container) return;
  
  const total = active_data.length;
  const priv = active_data.filter(d => d.group === "Privileged");
  const disadv = active_data.filter(d => d.group === "Disadvantaged");
  
  const privPos = priv.filter(d => d.class === "Positive").length;
  const privNeg = priv.filter(d => d.class === "Negative").length;
  
  const disadvPos = disadv.filter(d => d.class === "Positive").length;
  const disadvNeg = disadv.filter(d => d.class === "Negative").length;
  
  const flipped = disadv.filter(d => d.original_class === "Positive" && d.class === "Negative").length;

  const privPosPct = priv.length > 0 ? Math.round(privPos/priv.length*100) : 0;
  const privNegPct = priv.length > 0 ? Math.round(privNeg/priv.length*100) : 0;
  const disadvPosPct = disadv.length > 0 ? Math.round(disadvPos/disadv.length*100) : 0;
  const disadvNegPct = disadv.length > 0 ? Math.round(disadvNeg/disadv.length*100) : 0;

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-around; font-size: 13px; color: #e2e8f0; line-height: 1.5; background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">
      <div>
        <strong style="color: #60a5fa">Privileged Group (Circles):</strong> ${priv.length} (${Math.round(priv.length/total*100)}%)<br/>
        - <svg width="10" height="10" style="display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle; margin-right:3px"><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="4.5" fill="#1f77b4"/></svg> Positive: ${privPos} (${privPosPct}%)<br/>
        - <svg width="10" height="10" style="display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle; margin-right:3px"><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="4.5" fill="#d62728"/></svg> Negative: ${privNeg} (${privNegPct}%)
      </div>
      <div>
        <strong style="color: #f87171">Disadvantaged Group (Crosses):</strong> ${disadv.length} (${Math.round(disadv.length/total*100)}%)<br/>
        - <svg width="10" height="10" style="display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle; margin-right:3px"><path d="M1,1 L9,9 M9,1 L1,9" stroke="#1f77b4" stroke-width="2"/></svg> Positive: ${disadvPos} (${disadvPosPct}%)<br/>
        - <svg width="10" height="10" style="display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle; margin-right:3px"><path d="M1,1 L9,9 M9,1 L1,9" stroke="#d62728" stroke-width="2"/></svg> Negative: ${disadvNeg} (${disadvNegPct}%)
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}
```
